metaDescription: Order custom hiking lanyards and badges for your outdoor team. Perfect for events, safety IDs, and trail groups. Shop now at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: For hiking clubs, trail maintenance crews, or outdoor event staff, custom hiking lanyards and badges combine durability with outdoor-ready design. Choose breakaway safety lanyards in earth-tone colors like forest green or trail tan, and pair them with rugged PVC badges that resist moisture and scratches. Ideal for group identification on group hikes, volunteer trail days, or guided excursions, these accessories keep IDs visible without getting in the way of the trail.
heroAltText: Custom hiking lanyards and badges with breakaway safety clasps and earthy colors for outdoor use
